description:
REFINE THIS COMPLETE ARMOR into a clean premium RUNE SENTINEL and DESIGN BOTH ADDONS, ALL36 frames TOGETHER. Existing outfit is the EDIT TARGET, not accepted art: remove white speckling and inconsistent armor surfaces, keep substantial plate construction. Don't simplify into plain Citizen.
240x240 6x6 cells40px: cols0-2=NORTH(even rows)/SOUTH(odd rows) idle/walkA/walkB; cols3-5=EAST(even)/WEST(odd). Rows0-1=complete BASE; rows2-3=SAME BASE+ADDON1; rows4-5=SAME BASE+ADDON1+ADDON2. ALL cells full figures.
Keep base clothing IDENTICAL in matching poses across tiers; ONLY head crest and shoulder equipment change. Preserve every originally opaque body pixel, native silhouette/pose and original faces/hands. Do NOT erase/turn opaque costume transparent or shrink limbs. Keep diagonal Tibia projection.
BASE: strong fitted angular open-face helmet, sculpted PLATE cuirass with large readable diamond rune inset, layered short hip armor, strong waist belt, fitted bracers, charcoal cloth in joints, paired full shin plates and armored boots. Distinct broad metal plates and dark seams make a COMPLETE elite rune-order guard, not white clothes.
ADDON1 adds an attached LOW BACK-SWEPT RUNE CREST on existing helmet, clearly visible but NOT an oversized second helmet. Same geometry turning with head in all4 facings.
ADDON2 adds TWO substantial fitted stepped angular PAULDRONS and short ceremonial collar, with dark undersides and connected light top planes. Attach to shoulders; never float above head or move to elbows.
Clean connected metal surfaces: 8-10 GRAYSCALE tones; smooth broad medium-gray plate faces with short connected light-gray edge clusters. No white pin dots, speckles, scratches, dithering, confetti, checkerboard or tiny etching. All costume/addons/rune neutral grayscale. Keep plate edges and paired leg coverage consistent in all12 poses. No text, weapons, cape, flag, shield or effects.
context_usage: Complete native references: left480px has Warrior(top), Demon Hunter(middle), Wayfarer(bottom); each240px-high band contains full art(LEFT240px) and exact recolor mask(RIGHT240px). Each complete reference follows SAME36-cell layout as target: base, base+addon1, base+both, all4 headings and idle+both walking phases. Right top240x240 at(480,0) is the armor EDIT TARGET repeated over all three tiers, awaiting clean redesign and addons. Right middle and bottom show full equipped examples and player tinting. Use actual native outfit pixel style, addon attachment, coherent equipment rotation and gait. Existing armor target is unfinished; native reference outfits remain style/structure authority. Keep exact original anatomy, original fixed skin and all opaque body coverage. Generate ALL36 together, not one angle then rotations.
review_reason: Armor structure improved but helmet/shoulder additions insufficiently consistent; further reference-driven pass used.
